svg.title: DSpark and DFlash-style training attention: actual packed context-first layout
svg.desc: Source-aligned CP=1 packed layout: all context keys first, followed by all draft keys. Two documents contain 48 and 36 context tokens. Five anchors each own seven query rows. Q has 35 rows and KV has 119 rows. A query sees only its own document prefix before its anchor and its own complete draft block. cuDNN cumulative lengths delimit the single packed row; intervals isolate documents within it. RoPE uses document-local positions.
svg.metadata: Original ASpec explanatory artwork. Copyright 2026 Ant Group Co., Ltd. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0. Logical CP=1 layout; toy lengths and inspection windows, not a measured GPU tile layout.
svg.text: Each anchor expands B=7 query rows: a document prefix plus one complete 7×7 draft block.
Visible keys = [context start, context start + local anchor) ∪ [own draft start, own draft end)
This needs a flexible mask, while whole empty tiles provide an opportunity to skip work.
No QK / PV MMA for this tile.
A bit marks a visible score; it does not make a dense MMA instruction skip individual masked multiplications.
Mask shown: full attention within each draft block, no extra sliding window, all anchors valid.
Toy document lengths and inspection windows are for illustration; they are not the benchmark lengths or GPU tile geometry.
cuDNN THD: Q [35, Hq, D], K/V [119, Hkv, D]; cu_seqlens_q = [0, 35], cu_seqlens_k = [0, 119].
One packed row; intervals isolate documents inside it. RoPE uses document-local positions, not physical KV offsets.
